title: 128K-1M Long-Context Tiered KV Cache Offload (HBM -> Pinned DRAM -> NVMe/3FS GDS), 2D Context Parallelism (Ulysses x Ring) & MLA/Hybrid Attention Sizing Guide

tiers.tier: Tier 1: HBM-Only KV Cache + Round-Robin Gateway (Eviction Triggers Full 128K O(S^2) Prefill Recompute)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Unusable for multi-turn 128K agents due to constant HBM eviction and 5.2s recompute stalls

tiers.tier: Tier 2: GQA-8 FP8 KV + Local Host Pinned DRAM Offload over PCIe Gen5
tiers.recommended_scenario: Single-node 128K RAG deployments with sticky session routing

tiers.tier: Tier 3: 2D Context Parallelism (Ulysses x Ring) + Distributed Mooncake/LMCache RDMA DRAM Pool
tiers.recommended_scenario: Multi-node 128K-256K GQA-8 clusters pooling cluster-wide CPU DRAM via RDMA

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): MLA / 7:1 Hybrid Attention + 2D USP + 3-Tier KV Pool (HBM -> DRAM -> 3FS/NVMe GDS)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Production flagship architecture for 128K-1M coding/research agents (66.7x faster TTFT & -91.6% $/1M)
